2196                f"{name}: below the spearman floor"
2197                f" (|rho| = {abs(rho):.3f} < {min_abs_spearman}); not"
2198                " tested (shrinks the Bonferroni family)"
2199            )
2200            continue
2201        tested[name] = candidate_series
2202    n_tested = len(tested)
2203    if n_tested == 0:
2204        return DiscoveryReport(
2205            label=label,
2206            n_candidates=0,
2207            t_gate=float("nan"),
2208            discovered=[],
2209            all_below_threshold=True,
2210            note=_DISCOVERY_NOTE,
2211            notes=[
2212                *notes,
2213                "every candidate fell below the spearman floor",
2214            ],
2215        )
2216    if orthogonal_threshold is None:
2217        t_gate = float(norm.isf(_ALPHA / n_tested / 2.0))
2218        notes.append(
2219            f"Bonferroni t-gate from alpha/{n_tested}: |t| >= {t_gate:.3f}"
2220        )
2221    else:
2222        if not np.isfinite(orthogonal_threshold) or (
2223            orthogonal_threshold <= 0
2224        ):
2225            raise ValueError(
2226                "orthogonal_threshold must be a positive finite float,"
2227                f" got {orthogonal_threshold!r}"
2228            )
2229        t_gate = float(orthogonal_threshold)
2230    discovered: list[DiscoveryEntry] = []
2231    for name, candidate_series in tested.items():
2232        aligned = align_inputs(
2233            outcome_series, candidate_series, *control_series
2234        )
2235        aligned_out = aligned[0]
2236        aligned_feat = aligned[1]
2237        design = np.column_stack([np.ones(aligned_out.size), *aligned[1:]])
2238        fit = ols_hc0(aligned_out, design)
2239        t_stat = float(fit["t"][1])
2240        rho, rho_p = _spearman_pair(aligned_feat, aligned_out)
2241        monotone = bool(
2242            np.isfinite(rho) and np.isfinite(rho_p) and rho_p <= _SPEAR_P_GATE
2243        )
2244        if np.isfinite(t_stat) and abs(t_stat) >= t_gate:
2245            p_two_sided = (
2246                2.0 * float(stats.t.sf(abs(t_stat), fit["df"]))
2247                if np.isfinite(t_stat)
2248                else 1.0
2249            )
2250            discovered.append(
2251                DiscoveryEntry(
2252                    feature=name,
2253                    t_stat=t_stat,
2254                    monotone=monotone,
2255                    p_bonferroni=float(min(1.0, p_two_sided * n_tested)),
2256                )
2257            )
2258    return DiscoveryReport(
2259        label=label,
2260        n_candidates=n_tested,
2261        t_gate=t_gate,
2262        discovered=discovered,
2263        all_below_threshold=len(discovered) == 0,
2264        note=_DISCOVERY_NOTE,
2265        notes=notes,
2266    )
2267
2268
2269# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2270# 9. feature_importance (checkpoint A3; diagnostics only)
2271# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2272def feature_importance(
2273    outcome: Any,
2274    features: dict[str, Any],
2275    *,
2276    model: str = "linear",
2277    n_permutations: int = 100,
2278    seed: int = 42,
2279    label: str = "unnamed",
2280) -> ImportanceReport:
2281    """Permutation importance of each feature for ONE fitted model.
2282
2283    ``model="linear"`` fits OLS on standardized features;
2284    ``model="tree"`` fits a seeded RandomForest (200 trees, depth 4).
2285    Importance = sklearn permutation importance against R2 with
2286    ``n_repeats=n_permutations``; ``ci_lo`` / ``ci_hi`` are
2287    ``mean +/- 1.96 * std`` of the permutation repeats.  This is a
2288    DIAGNOSTIC: it feeds no classification cell, names no top
2289    feature, and a high importance never rescues a PROXY verdict.
2290
2291    Args:
2292        outcome: response series.
2293        features: mapping feature name -> single column.
2294        model: ``"linear"`` or ``"tree"``.
2295        n_permutations: permutation repeats; at least 1.
2296        seed: non-negative seed for the permutation draws (and the
2297            forest's random_state).
2298        label: free-text tag stored under ``report["label"]``.
2299
2300    Returns:
2301        :class:`ImportanceReport` with one entry per feature.
2302
2303    Raises:
2304        ValueError: if ``model`` is unknown, ``n_permutations`` < 1,
2305            ``seed`` is negative, ``features`` is empty, or fewer
2306            rows than features + 1 survive alignment.
2307
2308    Example::
2309
2310        >>> import numpy as np
2311        >>> import pandas as pd
2312        >>> rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
2313        >>> idx = pd.RangeIndex(400)
2314        >>> feat_a = pd.Series(rng.standard_normal(400), index=idx)
2315        >>> feat_b = pd.Series(rng.standard_normal(400), index=idx)
2316        >>> out = pd.Series(2.0 * feat_a + rng.standard_normal(400),
2317        ...                 index=idx)
2318        >>> report = feature_importance(
2319        ...     out, {"a": feat_a, "b": feat_b}, n_permutations=20
2320        ... )
2321        >>> report["features"]["a"]["importance_mean"] > (
2322        ...     report["features"]["b"]["importance_mean"]
2323        ... )
2324        True
2325    """
2326    if model not in ("linear", "tree"):
2327        raise ValueError(f"model must be 'linear' or 'tree', got {model!r}")
2328    validate_int("n_permutations", n_permutations)
2329    validate_int("seed", seed, minimum=0)
2330    if not features:
2331        raise ValueError("features dict must not be empty")
2332    names = list(features)
2333    aligned = align_inputs(
2334        _to_series(outcome, "outcome"),
2335        *(_to_series(features[name], name) for name in names),
2336    )
2337    outcome_values = aligned[0]
2338    design = np.column_stack(aligned[1:])
2339    n_rows = int(outcome_values.size)
2340    if n_rows <= len(names) + 1:
2341        raise ValueError(
2342            f"too few rows ({n_rows}) for {len(names)} features;"
2343            " importance is undefined"
2344        )
2345    notes: list[str] = []
2346    means = design.mean(axis=0)
2347    stds = design.std(axis=0)
2348    stds[stds == 0.0] = 1.0
2349    design_std = (design - means) / stds
2350    if model == "linear":
2351        fitted = LinearRegression().fit(design_std, outcome_values)
2352    else:
2353        fitted = RandomForestRegressor(
2354            n_estimators=200, max_depth=4, random_state=seed, n_jobs=1
2355        ).fit(design_std, outcome_values)
2356    result = permutation_importance(
2357        fitted,
2358        design_std,
2359        outcome_values,
2360        n_repeats=n_permutations,
2361        random_state=seed,
2362        scoring="r2",
2363    )
2364    entries: dict[str, ImportanceEntry] = {}
2365    for position, name in enumerate(names):
2366        mean_value = float(result.importances_mean[position])
2367        std_value = float(result.importances_std[position])
2368        entries[name] = ImportanceEntry(
2369            importance_mean=mean_value,
2370            importance_std=std_value,
2371            ci_lo=mean_value - 1.96 * std_value,
2372            ci_hi=mean_value + 1.96 * std_value,
2373        )
2374    notes.append(
2375        "diagnostic only: importance feeds no classification cell"
2376        " (see the module docstring)"
2377    )
2378    return ImportanceReport(
2379        label=label,
2380        model=model,
2381        n_permutations=n_permutations,
2382        features=entries,
2383        notes=notes,
2384    )
2385
2386
2387# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2388# 10. auto_rule_generation (checkpoint A3; EXPLORATORY by construction)
2389# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2390def _parse_multi_rule_template(
2391    rule_template: str,
2392    feature_names: list[str],
2393    max_depth: int,
2394) -> list[tuple[str, Any, str]]:
2395    """Parse an AND-of-comparisons template, clause by clause.
2396
2397    Returns one ``(placeholder, op_func, feature_name)`` triple per
2398    clause (template order).  Every clause must read
2399    ``"<feature> <op> {tN}"`` with its own placeholder; unknown
2400    features, unknown operators, duplicate placeholders and depths
2401    beyond ``max_depth`` all raise ValueError.  Templates are
2402    parsed, never ``eval``-ed.
2403    """
2404    clauses = [clause.strip() for clause in rule_template.split("&")]
2405    if not clauses or any(not clause for clause in clauses):
2406        raise ValueError(
2407            f"rule template must be non-empty AND-clauses: {rule_template!r}"
2408        )
2409    if len(clauses) > max_depth:
2410        raise ValueError(
2411            f"rule template has {len(clauses)} clauses, above the"
2412            f" max_depth {max_depth}"
2413        )
2414    placeholders: list[str] = []
2415    parsed: list[tuple[str, Any, str]] = []
2416    for clause in clauses:
2417        tokens = clause.split()
2418        if len(tokens) != 3:
2419            raise ValueError(
2420                f"clause {clause!r} must read '<feature> <op> {{tN}}'"
2421            )
2422        feature_token, op, placeholder_token = tokens
2423        if op not in _ALLOWED_OPS:
2424            raise ValueError(
2425                f"clause {clause!r}: operator must be one of"
2426                f" {list(_ALLOWED_OPS)}, got {op!r}"
2427            )
2428        if feature_token not in feature_names:
2429            raise ValueError(
2430                f"clause {clause!r}: feature {feature_token!r} is not"
2431                " a declared feature"
2432            )
2433        match = re.fullmatch(r"\{(t\d*)\}", placeholder_token)
2434        if match is None:
2435            raise ValueError(
2436                f"clause {clause!r}: placeholder must look like"
2437                " {{tN}}, got"
2438                f" {placeholder_token!r}"
2439            )
2440        placeholder = match.group(1)
2441        if placeholder in placeholders:
2442            raise ValueError(
2443                f"rule template reuses placeholder {placeholder!r};"
2444                " each clause needs its own"
2445            )
2446        placeholders.append(placeholder)
2447        parsed.append((placeholder, _OP_FUNCS[op], feature_token))
2448    return parsed
2449
2450
2451def auto_rule_generation(
2452    outcome: Any,
2453    features: dict[str, Any],
2454    rule_specs: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
2455    *,
2456    max_depth: int = 2,
2457    top_k: int = 5,
2458    min_n_train_kept: int = 100,
2459    train_idx: Any,
2460    test_idx: Any,
2461    label: str = "unnamed",
2462) -> AutoRuleReport:
2463    """Grid-search rule VALUES on train; the test split judges them.
2464
2465    The caller fixes the rule SHAPE (an AND-of-comparisons template
2466    like ``"feat_a < {t1} & feat_b <= {t2}"`` plus one grid per
2467    clause); the tool enumerates value combinations ON THE TRAIN
2468    SPLIT ONLY, keeps the ``top_k`` by ``delta_train``, and only then
2469    looks at the untouched test split.  Candidates whose
2470    ``delta_test`` is positive land in ``valid_rules``;
2471    ``overfit_warning`` fires when every kept candidate fails on
2472    test.  EXPLORATORY by construction: generation without a frozen
2473    downstream preregistration is exactly the winner's curse the
2474    framework exists to kill.
2475
2476    Args:
2477        outcome: response series WITHOUT NaN.
2478        features: mapping feature name -> single column (every
2479            template feature must be declared here).
2480        rule_specs: ``{spec_name: {template: str, grids:
2481            [[values], ...]}}``; ``len(grids)`` must equal the
2482            template's clause count.
2483        max_depth: clause-count cap (at least 1).
2484        top_k: how many train winners face the test split; at
2485            least 1.
2486        min_n_train_kept: minimum kept rows on train for ``valid``.
2487        train_idx: positional train split.
2488        test_idx: positional test split (must not overlap).
2489        label: free-text tag stored under ``report["label"]``.
2490
2491    Returns:
2492        :class:`AutoRuleReport` with ``candidates`` ordered by
2493        ``delta_train`` (best first).
2494
2495    Raises:
2496        ValueError: on template deviations (see
2497            :func:`_parse_multi_rule_template`), a grid count or
2498            combo count mismatch, an over-cap grid product
2499            (:data:`_MAX_COMBOS`), NaN outcome, or bad splits.
2500
2501    Example::
2502
2503        >>> import numpy as np
2504        >>> import pandas as pd
2505        >>> rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
2506        >>> rows = np.arange(600)
2507        >>> feat = pd.Series(rng.uniform(0, 1, 600), index=rows)
2508        >>> out = pd.Series(
2509        ...     np.where(feat < 0.5, 1.0, 0.0)
2510        ...     + 0.1 * rng.standard_normal(600), index=rows
2511        ... )
2512        >>> report = auto_rule_generation(
2513        ...     out, {"feat": feat},
2514        ...     {"low": {"template": "feat < {t1}",
2515        ...              "grids": [[0.4, 0.5, 0.6]]}},
2516        ...     min_n_train_kept=30,
2517        ...     train_idx=np.arange(400), test_idx=np.arange(400, 600),
2518        ... )
2519        >>> report["best_valid_rule"] is not None
2520        True
2521        >>> report["overfit_warning"]
2522        False
2523    """
2524    if not rule_specs:
2525        raise ValueError("rule_specs must not be empty")
2526    validate_int("max_depth", max_depth, minimum=1)
2527    validate_int("top_k", top_k, minimum=1)
2528    validate_int("min_n_train_kept", min_n_train_kept, minimum=1)
2529    feature_names = list(features)
2530    notes: list[str] = []
2531    outcome_series = _to_series(outcome, "outcome")
2532    if bool(outcome_series.isna().any()):
2533        raise ValueError(
2534            "outcome contains NaN; align and drop rows before"
2535            " auto_rule_generation"
2536        )
2537    outcome_values = outcome_series.to_numpy(dtype=float)
2538    train_positions = np.asarray(train_idx, dtype=int).reshape(-1)
2539    test_positions = np.asarray(test_idx, dtype=int).reshape(-1)
2540    if train_positions.size == 0 or test_positions.size == 0:
2541        raise ValueError("train_idx and test_idx must both be non-empty")
2542    if set(train_positions.tolist()) & set(test_positions.tolist()):
2543        raise ValueError("train_idx and test_idx overlap")
2544    total = outcome_values.size
2545    for tag, positions in (
2546        ("train_idx", train_positions),
2547        ("test_idx", test_positions),
2548    ):
2549        if positions.min() < 0 or positions.max() >= total:
2550            raise ValueError(
2551                f"{tag} out of range for outcome of {total} rows"
2552            )
2553    feature_columns = {
2554        name: _to_series(features[name], name).to_numpy(dtype=float)
2555        for name in feature_names
2556    }
2557    train_out = outcome_values[train_positions]
2558    train_rows = train_out.size
2559    evaluated: list[tuple[AutoRuleCandidate, str, tuple[float, ...]]] = []
2560    templates: dict[str, str] = {}
2561    for spec_name, spec in rule_specs.items():
2562        template, parsed, grid_lists = _validate_rule_spec(
2563            spec_name, spec, feature_names, max_depth
2564        )
2565        templates[spec_name] = template
2566        evaluated.extend(
2567            _train_combo_entry(
2568                spec_name,
2569                template,
2570                parsed,
2571                combo,
2572                feature_columns=feature_columns,
2573                train_positions=train_positions,
2574                train_out=train_out,
2575                train_rows=train_rows,
2576            )
2577            for combo in product(*grid_lists)
2578        )
2579    finite = [
2580        entry for entry in evaluated if np.isfinite(entry[0]["delta_train"])
2581    ]
2582    if not finite:
2583        return AutoRuleReport(
2584            label=label,
2585            templates=templates,
2586            candidates=[],
2587            valid_rules=[],
2588            best_valid_rule=None,
2589            overfit_warning=True,
2590            notes=[
2591                *notes,
2592                "every grid combo left one train side empty",
2593            ],
2594        )
2595    finite.sort(key=lambda entry: entry[0]["delta_train"], reverse=True)
2596    top_entries = finite[:top_k]
2597    top_candidates = [entry[0] for entry in top_entries]
2598    _judge_test_entries(
2599        top_entries,
2600        templates,
2601        feature_columns,
2602        feature_names,
2603        max_depth,
2604        outcome_values=outcome_values,
2605        test_positions=test_positions,
2606        min_n_train_kept=min_n_train_kept,
2607    )
2608    valid_names = [
2609        candidate["name"]
2610        for candidate in top_candidates
2611        if candidate["status"] == "valid"
2612    ]
2613    best_valid: str | None = None
2614    if valid_names:
2615        by_name = {
2616            candidate["name"]: candidate for candidate in top_candidates
2617        }
2618        best_valid = max(
2619            valid_names, key=lambda name: by_name[name]["delta_test"]
2620        )
2621    overfit_warning = all(
2622        candidate["status"] != "valid" for candidate in top_candidates
2623    )
2624    return AutoRuleReport(
2625        label=label,
2626        templates=templates,
2627        candidates=top_candidates,
2628        valid_rules=valid_names,
2629        best_valid_rule=best_valid,
2630        overfit_warning=overfit_warning,
2631        notes=notes,
2632    )
2633
2634
2635def _validate_rule_spec(
2636    spec_name: str,
2637    spec: Any,
2638    feature_names: list[str],
2639    max_depth: int,
2640) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, Any, str]], list[list[float]]]:
2641    """Validate one rule spec: shape, grids, and the combo cap.
2642
2643    Returns the template, its parsed clauses and the float grids;
2644    every deviation (missing keys, clause/grid mismatch, an empty
2645    grid, a product over :data:`_MAX_COMBOS`) raises ValueError.
2646    """
2647    if (
2648        not isinstance(spec, dict)
2649        or "template" not in spec
2650        or ("grids" not in spec)
2651    ):
2652        raise ValueError(
2653            f"rule spec {spec_name!r} must carry 'template' and 'grids'"
2654        )
2655    template = str(spec["template"])
2656    grids = spec["grids"]
2657    parsed = _parse_multi_rule_template(template, feature_names, max_depth)
2658    if len(grids) != len(parsed):
2659        raise ValueError(
2660            f"rule spec {spec_name!r}: {len(parsed)} clauses but"
2661            f" {len(grids)} grids"
2662        )
2663    grid_lists = [[float(value) for value in grid] for grid in grids]
2664    if any(not grid for grid in grid_lists):
2665        raise ValueError(
2666            f"rule spec {spec_name!r}: every grid must be non-empty"
2667        )
2668    combo_count = 1
2669    for grid in grid_lists:
2670        combo_count *= len(grid)
2671    if combo_count > _MAX_COMBOS:
2672        raise ValueError(
2673            f"rule spec {spec_name!r}: grid product {combo_count}"
2674            f" exceeds the cap {_MAX_COMBOS}; shrink the grids"
2675        )
2676    return template, parsed, grid_lists
2677
2678
2679def _train_combo_entry(
2680    spec_name: str,
2681    template: str,
2682    parsed: list[tuple[str, Any, str]],
2683    combo: tuple[float, ...],
2684    *,
2685    feature_columns: dict[str, np.ndarray],
2686    train_positions: np.ndarray,
2687    train_out: np.ndarray,
2688    train_rows: int,
2689) -> tuple[AutoRuleCandidate, str, tuple[float, ...]]:
2690    """Build one grid combo's TRAIN-side candidate (generation only).
2691
2692    The mask is evaluated on the train rows exclusively; the test
2693    fields stay empty (``delta_test`` NaN, status ``pending``) until
2694    the top-k judging pass.
2695    """
2696    mask = np.ones(train_rows, dtype=bool)
2697    for value, (_placeholder, op_func, feature_token) in zip(
2698        combo, parsed, strict=True
2699    ):
2700        mask &= op_func(
2701            feature_columns[feature_token][train_positions], value
2702        )
2703    kept = train_out[mask]
2704    dropped = train_out[~mask]
2705    delta_train = (
2706        float(np.mean(kept) - np.mean(dropped))
2707        if kept.size and dropped.size
2708        else float("nan")
2709    )
2710    render = {
2711        parsed[position][0]: combo[position]
2712        for position in range(len(parsed))
2713    }
2714    candidate = AutoRuleCandidate(
2715        name=f"{spec_name}:{combo}",
2716        rule_str=template.format(**render),
2717        n_train_kept=int(kept.size),
2718        n_test_kept=0,
2719        delta_train=delta_train,
2720        delta_test=float("nan"),
2721        status="pending",
2722    )
2723    return candidate, spec_name, combo
2724
2725
2726def _judge_test_entries(
2727    top_entries: list[tuple[AutoRuleCandidate, str, tuple[float, ...]]],
2728    templates: dict[str, str],
2729    feature_columns: dict[str, np.ndarray],
2730    feature_names: list[str],
2731    max_depth: int,
2732    *,
2733    outcome_values: np.ndarray,
2734    test_positions: np.ndarray,
2735    min_n_train_kept: int,
2736) -> None:
2737    """Face the top train winners with the untouched test split.
2738
2739    Mutates each candidate in place: fills ``n_test_kept`` /
2740    ``delta_test`` and applies the status ladder (n guard first,
2741    then both-deltas-positive = valid, anything else = unstable).
2742    """
2743    total = outcome_values.size
2744    for candidate, spec_name, combo in top_entries:
2745        parsed = _parse_multi_rule_template(
2746            templates[spec_name], feature_names, max_depth
2747        )
2748        mask = np.ones(total, dtype=bool)
2749        for value, (_placeholder, op_func, feature_token) in zip(
2750            combo, parsed, strict=True
2751        ):
2752            mask &= op_func(feature_columns[feature_token], value)
2753        kept = outcome_values[test_positions][mask[test_positions]]
2754        dropped = outcome_values[test_positions][~mask[test_positions]]
2755        delta_test = (
2756            float(np.mean(kept) - np.mean(dropped))
2757            if kept.size and dropped.size
2758            else float("nan")
2759        )
2760        candidate["n_test_kept"] = int(kept.size)
2761        candidate["delta_test"] = delta_test
2762        if (
2763            not np.isfinite(delta_test)
2764            or candidate["n_train_kept"] < min_n_train_kept
2765            or kept.size == 0
2766            or dropped.size == 0
2767        ):
2768            candidate["status"] = "insufficient_n"
2769        elif delta_test > 0.0 and candidate["delta_train"] > 0.0:
2770            candidate["status"] = "valid"
2771        else:
2772            candidate["status"] = "unstable"
2773
2774
2775# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2776# orchestrator
2777# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2778def _run_interactions(
2779    outcome: Any,
2780    features: dict[str, Any],
2781    interaction_pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] | None,
2782    min_cell_n: int,
2783) -> dict[str, InteractionScanReport]:
2784    """Run every requested pair through :func:`interaction_scan`.
2785
2786    Both pair names must be declared features and must differ; the
2787    report key is ``"nameAxnameB"``.
2788    """
2789    interactions: dict[str, InteractionScanReport] = {}
2790    for first_name, second_name in interaction_pairs or []:
2791        if first_name not in features or second_name not in features:
2792            raise ValueError(
2793                f"interaction pair ({first_name!r}, {second_name!r}):"
2794                " both names must be declared features"
2795            )
2796        if first_name == second_name:
2797            raise ValueError(
2798                f"interaction pair ({first_name!r}, {second_name!r}):"
2799                " a feature cannot interact with itself"
2800            )
2801        pair_key = f"{first_name}x{second_name}"
2802        interactions[pair_key] = interaction_scan(
2803            outcome,
2804            features[first_name],
2805            features[second_name],
2806            min_cell_n=min_cell_n,
2807            name_a=first_name,
2808            name_b=second_name,
2809            label=pair_key,
2810        )
2811    return interactions
2812
2813
2814def _run_threshold_sweeps(
2815    outcome: Any,
2816    features: dict[str, Any],
2817    threshold_specs: dict[str, list[float]] | None,
2818    threshold_template: str | None,
2819    *,
2820    train_idx: Any | None,
2821    test_idx: Any | None,
2822    min_n_kept: int,
2823) -> dict[str, ThresholdScanReport] | None:
2824    """Run every spec'd feature through :func:`threshold_scan`.
2825
2826    The template's ``{feature}`` token is substituted textually (the
2827    ``{t}`` placeholder stays for the sweep); ``None`` specs return
2828    ``None``; specs without a frozen split raise.
2829    """
2830    if threshold_specs is None:
2831        return None
2832    if train_idx is None or test_idx is None:
2833        raise ValueError(
2834            "threshold_specs requires BOTH train_idx and test_idx"
2835            " (the sweep deltas are train/test deltas)"
2836        )
2837    template_format = threshold_template or "{feature} < {t}"
2838    reports: dict[str, ThresholdScanReport] = {}
2839    for name, values in threshold_specs.items():
2840        if name not in features:
2841            raise ValueError(
2842                f"threshold_specs names {name!r}, which is not a"
2843                " declared feature"
2844            )
2845        sweep_template = template_format.replace("{feature}", name)
2846        reports[name] = threshold_scan(
2847            outcome,
2848            features[name],
2849            sweep_template,
2850            values,
2851            feature_name=name,
2852            train_idx=train_idx,
2853            test_idx=test_idx,
2854            min_n_kept=min_n_kept,
2855            label=name,
2856        )
2857    return reports
2858
2859
2860def _run_exploratory_blocks(
2861    outcome: Any,
2862    features: dict[str, Any],
2863    controls: dict[str, Any],
2864    *,
2865    discovery_pool: dict[str, Any] | None,
2866    discovery_min_abs_spearman: float,
2867    importance_model: str | None,
2868    importance_n_permutations: int,
2869    rule_generation_specs: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | None,
2870    rule_generation_top_k: int,
2871    train_idx: Any | None,
2872    test_idx: Any | None,
2873    seed: int,
2874    label: str,
2875) -> tuple[
2876    DiscoveryReport | None, ImportanceReport | None, AutoRuleReport | None
2877]:
2878    """Run the three EXPLORATORY blocks when (and only when) requested.
2879
2880    Discovery and importance need no split; rule generation requires
2881    BOTH split indices (generation is train-only, judging is
2882    test-only).  The outputs never touch the classification.
2883    """
2884    discovery = None
2885    if discovery_pool is not None:
2886        discovery = auto_discovery(
2887            outcome,
2888            discovery_pool,
2889            controls,
2890            min_abs_spearman=discovery_min_abs_spearman,
2891            label=label,
2892        )
2893    importance = None
2894    if importance_model is not None:
2895        importance = feature_importance(
2896            outcome,
2897            features,
2898            model=importance_model,
2899            n_permutations=importance_n_permutations,
2900            seed=seed,
2901            label=label,
2902        )
2903    rule_generation = None
2904    if rule_generation_specs is not None:
2905        if train_idx is None or test_idx is None:
2906            raise ValueError(
2907                "rule_generation_specs requires BOTH train_idx and"
2908                " test_idx (generation is train-only, judging is"
2909                " test-only)"
2910            )
2911        rule_generation = auto_rule_generation(
2912            outcome,
2913            features,
2914            rule_generation_specs,
2915            top_k=rule_generation_top_k,
2916            train_idx=train_idx,
2917            test_idx=test_idx,
2918            label=label,
2919        )
2920    return discovery, importance, rule_generation
2921
2922
2923def _classify_features(
2924    orth: OrthogonalReport,
2925    buckets: BucketScanReport,
2926    clustering: ClusterReport,
2927    rep_names: list[str],
2928    regime: RegimeScanReport | None,
2929    *,
2930    notes: list[str],
2931) -> tuple[dict[str, str], dict[str, str], dict[str, str]]:
2932    """Cells, actions and skip reasons for the representative features.
2933
2934    Ladder: not testable -> NOISE; orthogonal fail (gate or
2935    collinearity screen) -> PROXY; pass + non-monotone ->
2936    SHAPE_UNKNOWN; pass + monotone goes through the regime gate -- a
2937    VERIFIED indicator (status ``OK``, two-plus qualifying regimes)
2938    splits monotone features into STRONG (monotone in every
2939    qualifying regime) vs REGIME_DEPENDENT (monotone in some); any
2940    weaker regime setup (absent, UNVERIFIED, under-powered) keeps the
2941    cell STRONG_UNVERIFIED.  Cluster members are pointed at their
2942    representative in ``skipped_features`` and get no independent
2943    cell.
2944    """
2945    classification: dict[str, str] = {}
2946    actions: dict[str, str] = {}
2947    skipped: dict[str, str] = {}
2948    orth_kept = set(orth["features"])
2949    detected = orth["per_feature_detected"]
2950    for name in rep_names:
2951        if name not in orth_kept:
2952            skipped[name] = "noise"
2953            classification[name] = _CELL_NOISE
2954            actions[name] = _ACTION_DISCARD
2955        elif not detected.get(name, False):
2956            # covers both gate failures and the collinearity screen:
2957            # either way the column carries nothing beyond controls
2958            skipped[name] = "proxy"
2959            classification[name] = _CELL_PROXY
2960            actions[name] = _ACTION_DISCARD
2961        elif name not in buckets["features"]:
2962            skipped[name] = "not_bucketed"
2963            classification[name] = _CELL_SHAPE
2964            actions[name] = _ACTION_INTERACT
2965        elif buckets["features"][name]["monotone"]:
2966            classification[name], actions[name] = _monotone_cell(
2967                name, regime, notes
2968            )
2969        else:
2970            classification[name] = _CELL_SHAPE
2971            actions[name] = _ACTION_INTERACT
2972    for member, chosen in clustering["representatives"].items():
2973        if member != chosen:
2974            skipped[member] = f"cluster:{chosen}"
2975    notes.append(
2976        "classification covers representatives only; cluster members"
2977        " are pointed at their representative in skipped_features"
2978    )
2979    return classification, actions, skipped
2980
2981
2982def _monotone_cell(
2983    name: str,
2984    regime: RegimeScanReport | None,
2985    notes: list[str],
2986) -> tuple[str, str]:
2987    """Regime-gated cell for one orthogonally-detected monotone feature.
2988
2989    STRONG demands a VERIFIED indicator (prereg_hash -> status OK)
2990    with at least two qualifying regimes in which the feature is
2991    monotone; monotone-in-some reads REGIME_DEPENDENT; monotone-in-
2992    none (a global effect no single regime carries) falls back to
2993    SHAPE_UNKNOWN for interaction investigation; everything weaker
2994    stays STRONG_UNVERIFIED.
2995    """
2996    if regime is None:
2997        return _CELL_UNVERIFIED, _ACTION_PREREG
2998    if regime["status"] != "OK":
2999        notes.append(
3000            f"{name}: regime indicator {regime['regime_name']!r} is"
3001            f" {regime['status']}; cell stays STRONG_UNVERIFIED"
3002        )
3003        return _CELL_UNVERIFIED, _ACTION_PREREG
3004    regime_flags = regime["features"].get(name, {})
3005    qualifying = [
3006        regime_key
3007        for regime_key, entry in regime_flags.items()
3008        if entry["n"] >= regime["min_regime_n"]
3009    ]
3010    if len(qualifying) < 2:
3011        notes.append(
3012            f"{name}: fewer than 2 qualifying regimes in verified"
3013            f" indicator {regime['regime_name']!r}; cell stays"
3014            " STRONG_UNVERIFIED"
3015        )
3016        return _CELL_UNVERIFIED, _ACTION_PREREG
3017    flags = [regime_flags[key]["monotone"] for key in qualifying]
3018    if all(flags):
3019        return _CELL_STRONG, _ACTION_BUILD
3020    if any(flags):
3021        return _CELL_REGIME, _ACTION_REGIME_FILTER
3022    notes.append(
3023        f"{name}: globally monotone but monotone in no single regime;"
3024        " cell falls back to SHAPE_UNKNOWN for interaction"
3025        " investigation"
3026    )
3027    return _CELL_SHAPE, _ACTION_INTERACT
3028
3029
3030def _resolve_inputs(
3031    outcome: MaterializedData | pd.Series,
3032    features: dict[str, Any] | pd.DataFrame | None,
3033    controls: dict[str, Any] | pd.DataFrame | None,
3034    notes: list[str],
3035) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
3036    """Resolve the outcome union into plain name -> column maps.
3037
3038    A :class:`~atropos.data_contract.MaterializedData` bundle is the
3039    contract path: its manifest is VALIDATED here (failed lookahead
3040    checks or a failed validation battery are fatal; a missing
3041    manifest is a loud warning recorded in ``notes``) and its frames
3042    supply every column -- ``features``/``controls`` must then be
3043    ``None``.  The legacy path keeps the bare-Series semantics.
3044    """
3045    if isinstance(outcome, MaterializedData):
3046        if features is not None or controls is not None:
3047            raise ValueError(
3048                "outcome is a MaterializedData: features/controls"
3049                " come from the bundle itself and must be None"
3050            )
3051        manifest = outcome.manifest
3052        if manifest is None:
3053            notes.append(
3054                "unverified data, contract guarantees not applied"
3055                " (manifest is None)"
3056            )
3057        else:
3058            failed_lookahead = sorted(
3059                name
3060                for name, ok in manifest["lookahead_checks"].items()
3061                if not ok
3062            )
3063            if failed_lookahead:
3064                raise ValueError(
3065                    "MaterializedData lookahead check FAILED for"
3066                    f" {failed_lookahead}; refusing analysis"
3067                )
3068            if not manifest["validation"]["passed"]:
3069                raise ValueError(
3070                    "MaterializedData validation failed:"
3071                    " " + "; ".join(manifest["validation"]["fatal"])
3072                )
3073        feature_frame = outcome.features
3074        control_frame = outcome.controls
3075        features_map = {
3076            name: feature_frame[name] for name in feature_frame.columns
3077        }
3078        controls_map = {
3079            name: control_frame[name] for name in control_frame.columns
3080        }
3081        return features_map, controls_map
3082    features_arg = features if features is not None else {}
3083    controls_arg = controls if controls is not None else {}
3084    if isinstance(features_arg, pd.DataFrame):
3085        features_map = {
3086            name: features_arg[name] for name in features_arg.columns
3087        }
3088    else:
3089        features_map = dict(features_arg)
3090    if isinstance(controls_arg, pd.DataFrame):
3091        controls_map = {
3092            name: controls_arg[name] for name in controls_arg.columns
3093        }
3094    else:
3095        controls_map = dict(controls_arg)
3096    return features_map, controls_map
3097
3098
3099def feature_analysis(
3100    outcome: MaterializedData | pd.Series,
3101    features: dict[str, Any] | pd.DataFrame | None = None,
3102    controls: dict[str, Any] | pd.DataFrame | None = None,
3103    *,
3104    nan_threshold: float = 0.05,
3105    cluster_threshold: float = 0.8,
3106    representatives: dict[str, str] | None = None,
3107    orthogonal_threshold: float | None = None,
3108    n_perm_orth: int = 200,
3109    n_buckets: int = 5,
3110    bucket_edges: dict[str, list[float]] | None = None,
3111    min_bucket_n: int = 50,
3112    norm_r: Any | None = None,
3113    n_perm_bucket: int = 200,
3114    interaction_pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,
3115    min_cell_n: int = 30,
3116    candidate_rules: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
3117    train_idx: Any | None = None,
3118    test_idx: Any | None = None,
3119    regime_indicator: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
3120    min_regime_n: int = 100,
3121    threshold_specs: dict[str, list[float]] | None = None,
3122    threshold_template: str | None = None,
3123    min_n_kept: int = 100,
3124    discovery_pool: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
3125    discovery_min_abs_spearman: float = 0.15,
3126    importance_model: str | None = None,
3127    importance_n_permutations: int = 100,
3128    rule_generation_specs: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
3129    rule_generation_top_k: int = 5,
3130    seed: int = 42,
3131    label: str = "unnamed",
3132) -> FeatureAnalysisReport:
3133    """Chain the scans, then classify every representative feature.
3134
3135    Order (each stage feeds the next): missingness flags ->
3136    correlation clusters (Bonferroni family = ``n_effective``) ->
3137    orthogonal check on the REPRESENTATIVES with the derived t-gate
3138    (``alpha / n_effective`` two-sided normal quantile unless
3139    ``orthogonal_threshold`` overrides it) -> bucket scan on the
3140    orthogonally detected features -> interaction scans for the
3141    requested pairs -> rule fit when candidate rules AND a frozen
3142    split are supplied -> regime scan when an indicator is supplied
3143    (on the detected features) -> threshold sweeps when specs are
3144    supplied (requires the frozen split) -> classification ->
3145    recommended actions.
3146
3147    Classification (per representative): not testable -> ``NOISE``;
3148    orthogonal gate fail -> ``PROXY``; pass + non-monotone ->
3149    ``SHAPE_UNKNOWN``; pass + monotone goes through the regime gate:
3150    a VERIFIED indicator (``prereg_hash``, 2+ qualifying regimes)
3151    upgrades monotone-in-every-regime features to ``STRONG`` and
3152    monotone-in-some to ``REGIME_DEPENDENT``; anything weaker stays
3153    ``STRONG_UNVERIFIED``.  Cluster members get no independent cell:
3154    ``skipped_features`` points them at their representative.  The
3155    discovery/importance/rule-generation blocks land in checkpoint
3156    A3 and read ``None`` until then.
3157
3158    Args:
3159        outcome: a :class:`~atropos.data_contract.MaterializedData`
3160            bundle (the contract path -- its manifest is VALIDATED:
3161            a failed lookahead check or a failed validation battery
3162            is fatal, a missing manifest is a loud warning in the
3163            report notes) or the response series (legacy path).
3164        features: mapping feature name -> single column, or a
3165            DataFrame; ``None`` when ``outcome`` is a
3166            MaterializedData (the bundle carries the columns).
3167        controls: mapping control name -> single column, or a
3168            DataFrame; ``None`` when ``outcome`` is a
3169            MaterializedData.
3170        nan_threshold: missingness warn gate; in the open (0, 1).
3171        cluster_threshold: cluster cut level of |pearson|.
3172        representatives: optional explicit member -> representative
3173            map (see :func:`correlation_cluster`).
3174        orthogonal_threshold: explicit |t| gate for the orthogonal
3175            check; ``None`` derives ``alpha / n_effective``.
3176        n_perm_orth: permutation draws for the orthogonal check.
3177        n_buckets: requested bucket count for :func:`bucket_scan`.
3178        bucket_edges: optional per-feature prereg bucket edges.
3179        min_bucket_n: power floor per bucket (0 disables).
3180        norm_r: optional normalized-outcome column (see
3181            :func:`bucket_scan`).
3182        n_perm_bucket: permutation draws per bucket feature.
3183        interaction_pairs: optional list of ``(name_a, name_b)``
3184            pairs to test; both names must be declared features.
3185        min_cell_n: power floor per interaction cell.
3186        candidate_rules: optional rule masks for :func:`rule_fit`;
3187            requires ``train_idx`` AND ``test_idx``.
3188        train_idx: positional train split for ``candidate_rules`` and
3189            the threshold sweeps.
3190        test_idx: positional test split (see ``train_idx``).
3191        regime_indicator: optional ``{name, definition, prereg_hash,
3192            values}`` dict for :func:`regime_scan` (see there); the
3193            gate demands ``prereg_hash`` for a STRONG cell.
3194        min_regime_n: minimum rows per regime for the sign/monotone
3195            comparison.
3196        threshold_specs: optional ``{feature: [thresholds]}`` sweeps
3197            for :func:`threshold_scan`; requires the frozen split.
3198        threshold_template: optional format string with ``{feature}``
3199            and ``{t}`` placeholders (default ``"{feature} < {t}"``).
3200        min_n_kept: minimum kept rows per split for a ``valid``
3201            threshold point.
3202        discovery_pool: optional explicit candidate dict for
3203            :func:`auto_discovery` -- EXPLORATORY output, never
3204            merged into the classification.
3205        discovery_min_abs_spearman: spearman pre-filter floor for
3206            the discovery pool.
3207        importance_model: optional ``"linear"`` / ``"tree"`` for
3208            :func:`feature_importance` -- diagnostic only, feeds no
3209            cell.
3210        importance_n_permutations: permutation repeats for the
3211            importance runs.
3212        rule_generation_specs: optional ``{name: {template, grids}}``
3213            for :func:`auto_rule_generation`; requires the frozen
3214            split.  EXPLORATORY output.
3215        rule_generation_top_k: how many train winners face the test
3216            split.
3217        seed: non-negative seed threaded into every seeded step.
3218        label: free-text tag stored under ``report["label"]``.
3219
3220    Returns:
3221        :class:`FeatureAnalysisReport`; every schema key is present.
3222
3223    Raises:
3224        ValueError: if gate fractions are outside (0, 1), a pair name
3225            is not a declared feature, ``candidate_rules`` is given
3226            without both split indices, ``outcome`` is a
3227            MaterializedData whose manifest fails (lookahead check or
3228            validation battery), ``features``/``controls`` are passed
3229            alongside a MaterializedData, or any sub-scan raises.
3230
3231    Example::
3232
3233        >>> import numpy as np
3234        >>> import pandas as pd
3235        >>> rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
3236        >>> idx = pd.RangeIndex(500)
3237        >>> feat = pd.Series(rng.standard_normal(500), index=idx)
3238        >>> ctrl = pd.Series(rng.standard_normal(500), index=idx)
3239        >>> out = pd.Series(0.5 * feat + rng.standard_normal(500),
3240        ...                 index=idx)
3241        >>> report = feature_analysis(
3242        ...     out, {"feat": feat}, {"ctrl": ctrl},
3243        ...     n_perm_orth=25, n_perm_bucket=25, min_bucket_n=0,
3244        ...     label="demo",
3245        ... )
3246        >>> report["classification"]["feat"]
3247        'STRONG_UNVERIFIED'
3248    """
3249    _validate_fraction("nan_threshold", nan_threshold)
3250    _validate_fraction("cluster_threshold", cluster_threshold)
3251    validate_int("seed", seed, minimum=0)
3252    notes: list[str] = []
3253    feature_map, control_map = _resolve_inputs(
3254        outcome, features, controls, notes
3255    )
3256    outcome_series = (
3257        outcome.outcome if isinstance(outcome, MaterializedData) else outcome
3258    )
3259    if candidate_rules is not None and (
3260        train_idx is None or test_idx is None
3261    ):
3262        raise ValueError(
3263            "candidate_rules requires BOTH train_idx and test_idx"
3264            " (rule_fit has no default split)"
3265        )
3266    feature_names = list(feature_map)
3267
3268    missing = missingness_scan(
3269        outcome_series,
3270        feature_map,
3271        control_map,
3272        nan_threshold=nan_threshold,
3273        label=label,
3274    )
3275    clustering = correlation_cluster(
3276        feature_map,
3277        outcome_series,
3278        threshold=cluster_threshold,
3279        representatives=representatives,
3280        label=label,
3281    )
3282    rep_features = {
3283        name: feature_map[name]
3284        for name in feature_names
3285        if clustering["representatives"].get(name) == name
3286    }
3287    n_effective = clustering["n_effective"]
3288    if orthogonal_threshold is None:
3289        alpha_family = _ALPHA / n_effective
3290        orth_gate = float(norm.isf(alpha_family / 2.0))
3291        notes.append(
3292            f"orthogonal t-gate derived from alpha/{n_effective}:"
3293            f" |t| >= {orth_gate:.3f}"
3294        )
3295    else:
3296        if not np.isfinite(orthogonal_threshold) or orthogonal_threshold <= 0:
3297            raise ValueError(
3298                "orthogonal_threshold must be a positive finite float,"
3299                f" got {orthogonal_threshold!r}"
3300            )
3301        orth_gate = float(orthogonal_threshold)
3302    orth = orthogonal_check(
3303        outcome_series,
3304        rep_features,
3305        control_map,
3306        label=label,
3307        n_perm=n_perm_orth,
3308        seed=seed,
3309        t_threshold=orth_gate,
3310    )
3311    detected = orth["per_feature_detected"]
3312    bucket_targets = [name for name in rep_features if detected.get(name)]
3313    bucket_edges_kept = {
3314        name: edges
3315        for name, edges in (bucket_edges or {}).items()
3316        if name in bucket_targets
3317    }
3318    buckets = bucket_scan(
3319        outcome_series,
3320        {name: feature_map[name] for name in bucket_targets},
3321        n_buckets=n_buckets,
3322        bucket_edges=bucket_edges_kept or None,
3323        min_bucket_n=min_bucket_n,
3324        norm_r=norm_r,
3325        n_perm=n_perm_bucket,
3326        seed=seed,
3327        label=label,
3328    )
3329    interactions = _run_interactions(
3330        outcome_series, feature_map, interaction_pairs, min_cell_n
3331    )
3332    rules = None
3333    if candidate_rules is not None:
3334        rules = rule_fit(
3335            outcome_series,
3336            candidate_rules,
3337            train_idx=train_idx,
3338            test_idx=test_idx,
3339            label=label,
3340        )
3341    regime = None
3342    if regime_indicator is not None:
3343        regime = regime_scan(
3344            outcome_series,
3345            {name: feature_map[name] for name in bucket_targets},
3346            regime_indicator,
3347            min_regime_n=min_regime_n,
3348            label=label,
3349        )
3350    threshold_reports = _run_threshold_sweeps(
3351        outcome_series,
3352        feature_map,
3353        threshold_specs,
3354        threshold_template,
3355        train_idx=train_idx,
3356        test_idx=test_idx,
3357        min_n_kept=min_n_kept,
3358    )
3359    discovery, importance, rule_generation = _run_exploratory_blocks(
3360        outcome_series,
3361        feature_map,
3362        control_map,
3363        discovery_pool=discovery_pool,
3364        discovery_min_abs_spearman=discovery_min_abs_spearman,
3365        importance_model=importance_model,
3366        importance_n_permutations=importance_n_permutations,
3367        rule_generation_specs=rule_generation_specs,
3368        rule_generation_top_k=rule_generation_top_k,
3369        train_idx=train_idx,
3370        test_idx=test_idx,
3371        seed=seed,
3372        label=label,
3373    )
3374
3375    classification, actions, skipped = _classify_features(
3376        orth, buckets, clustering, list(rep_features), regime, notes=notes
3377    )
3378    if discovery is None and importance is None and (rule_generation is None):
3379        notes.append(
3380            "exploratory blocks (discovery, importance, rule"
3381            " generation) not requested; keys stay None"
3382        )
3383    return FeatureAnalysisReport(
3384        label=label,
3385        seed=seed,
3386        n_effective=n_effective,
3387        orthogonal_t_gate=orth_gate,
3388        missingness=missing,
3389        clustering=clustering,
3390        orthogonal=orth,
3391        buckets=buckets,
3392        interaction=interactions,
3393        rules=rules,
3394        regime=regime,
3395        threshold=threshold_reports,
3396        discovery=discovery,
3397        importance=importance,
3398        rule_generation=rule_generation,
3399        skipped_features=skipped,
3400        classification=classification,
3401        recommended_actions=actions,
3402        notes=notes,
3403    )
3404
3405

3408# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
3409def _demo_orchestrator(
3410    outcome: pd.Series,
3411    features: dict[str, pd.Series],
3412    controls: dict[str, pd.Series],
3413) -> None:
3414    """Demo block: the orchestrator classification on the planted world."""
3415    report = feature_analysis(
3416        outcome,
3417        features,
3418        controls,
3419        n_perm_orth=25,
3420        n_perm_bucket=25,
3421        min_bucket_n=0,
3422        label="feature_scan demo",
3423    )
3424    print(f"n_effective={report['n_effective']}")
3425    print(
3426        "orthogonal t-gate:",
3427        round(report["orthogonal_t_gate"], 3),
3428    )
3429    print("classification:", report["classification"])
3430    print("actions:", report["recommended_actions"])
3431    print("skipped:", report["skipped_features"])
3432    assert report["n_effective"] == 2
3433    assert report["classification"]["alpha_real"] == _CELL_UNVERIFIED
3434    assert report["classification"]["beta_null"] == _CELL_PROXY
3435    assert report["recommended_actions"]["alpha_real"] == _ACTION_PREREG
3436    assert report["rules"] is None and report["regime"] is None
3437    missing = report["missingness"]
3438    assert sorted(missing["features"]) == ["alpha_real", "beta_null"]
3439    assert missing["features"]["alpha_real"]["warn"] is False

3441
3442def _demo_bucket(outcome: pd.Series, features: dict[str, pd.Series]) -> None:
3443    """Demo block: the bucket profile + Q1/Q2 split."""
3444    bucket_report = bucket_scan(
3445        outcome,
3446        {"alpha_real": features["alpha_real"]},
3447        n_perm=25,
3448        seed=42,
3449    )
3450    profile = bucket_report["features"]["alpha_real"]
3451    print(
3452        "bucket profile: monotone=",
3453        profile["monotone"],
3454        " spearman=",
3455        round(profile["spearman"], 3),
3456        " p_perm=",
3457        profile["p_perm"],
3458    )
3459    assert profile["monotone"] is True
3460    assert profile["p_perm"] <= 0.05
3461    assert profile["q_split"]["net_r_signal"] is True
3462    assert bucket_report["norm_r_is_outcome"] is True
3463
3464
3465def _demo_interaction(
3466    outcome: pd.Series, features: dict[str, pd.Series]
3467) -> None:
3468    """Demo block: the additive world reads no interaction."""
3469    interaction = interaction_scan(
3470        outcome,
3471        features["alpha_real"],
3472        features["beta_null"],
3473        min_cell_n=30,
3474    )
3475    print(
3476        "interaction (additive world): present=",
3477        interaction["interaction_present"],
3478        " p_f=",
3479        round(interaction["p_f"], 3),
3480    )
3481    assert interaction["status"] == "OK"
3482    assert interaction["interaction_present"] is False
3483
3484
3485def _demo_rule_fit(outcome: pd.Series, real: np.ndarray, n_rows: int) -> None:
3486    """Demo block: a planted rule reads valid with a positive test delta."""
3487    rule_mask = (real > 0.0).astype(bool)
3488    rule_report = rule_fit(
3489        outcome,
3490        {"sign_rule": rule_mask},
3491        train_idx=np.arange(0, 500),
3492        test_idx=np.arange(500, n_rows),
3493        min_n_train=50,
3494        min_n_test=20,
3495    )
3496    print(
3497        "rule_fit sign_rule:",
3498        rule_report["rules"]["sign_rule"]["status"],
3499        " delta_test=",
3500        round(rule_report["rules"]["sign_rule"]["delta_test"], 4),
3501    )
3502    assert rule_report["rules"]["sign_rule"]["status"] == _STATUS_VALID
3503    assert rule_report["best_valid_rule"] == "sign_rule"
3504
3505
3506def _demo_missingness(
3507    outcome: pd.Series, features: dict[str, pd.Series]
3508) -> None:
3509    """Demo block: outcome-linked NaN warns, random NaN stays silent."""
3510    nan_feature = features["beta_null"].copy()
3511    nan_feature[outcome > 1.0] = np.nan
3512    missing_shift = missingness_scan(
3513        outcome, {"flagged": nan_feature}, {}, nan_threshold=0.05
3514    )
3515    print(
3516        "missingness (outcome-linked NaN): warn=",
3517        missing_shift["features"]["flagged"]["warn"],
3518        " differs=",
3519        missing_shift["features"]["flagged"]["nan_outcome_differs"],
3520    )
3521    assert missing_shift["features"]["flagged"]["warn"] is True
3522
3523
3524def _demo_discovery(
3525    outcome: pd.Series, features: dict[str, pd.Series]
3526) -> None:
3527    """Demo block: the planted pool yields one EXPLORATORY hypothesis."""
3528    discovery = auto_discovery(
3529        outcome,
3530        {
3531            "alpha_real": features["alpha_real"],
3532            "beta_null": features["beta_null"],
3533        },
3534        {},
3535        min_abs_spearman=0.0,
3536        label="discovery demo",
3537    )
3538    print(
3539        "discovery (planted pool):",
3540        [entry["feature"] for entry in discovery["discovered"]],
3541        "| all_below:",
3542        discovery["all_below_threshold"],
3543    )
3544    assert discovery["n_candidates"] == 2
3545    assert [entry["feature"] for entry in discovery["discovered"]] == [
3546        "alpha_real"
3547    ]
3548    assert "prereg + run_full_pipeline" in discovery["note"]
3549
3550
3551def _demo_importance(
3552    outcome: pd.Series, features: dict[str, pd.Series]
3553) -> None:
3554    """Demo block: the planted feature dominates permutation importance."""
3555    importance = feature_importance(
3556        outcome,
3557        features,
3558        model="linear",
3559        n_permutations=20,
3560        seed=42,
3561    )
3562    print(
3563        "importance (linear): alpha_real =",
3564        round(importance["features"]["alpha_real"]["importance_mean"], 4),
3565        "beta_null =",
3566        round(importance["features"]["beta_null"]["importance_mean"], 4),
3567    )
3568    assert (
3569        importance["features"]["alpha_real"]["importance_mean"]
3570        > importance["features"]["beta_null"]["importance_mean"]
3571    )
3572
3573
3574def _demo_rule_generation(
3575    outcome: pd.Series, features: dict[str, pd.Series], n_rows: int
3576) -> None:
3577    """Demo block: grid-searched rule shape validates on test."""
3578    rule_gen = auto_rule_generation(
3579        outcome,
3580        features,
3581        {
3582            "sign_rule": {
3583                "template": "alpha_real > {t1}",
3584                "grids": [[0.0, 0.3]],
3585            }
3586        },
3587        min_n_train_kept=50,
3588        train_idx=np.arange(0, 500),
3589        test_idx=np.arange(500, n_rows),
3590    )
3591    print(
3592        "rule generation: best =",
3593        rule_gen["best_valid_rule"],
3594        "| overfit_warning:",
3595        rule_gen["overfit_warning"],
3596    )
3597    assert rule_gen["best_valid_rule"] is not None
3598    assert rule_gen["overfit_warning"] is False
3599
3600
3601def run_all_examples() -> None:
3602    """Demo: one planted world through the whole chain, asserted.
3603
3604    Every printed verdict is asserted (in the per-block helpers), so
3605    a regression crashes the demo instead of printing a wrong number
3606    quietly.
3607    """
3608    n_rows = 800
3609    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
3610    real = rng.standard_normal(n_rows)
3611    null = rng.standard_normal(n_rows)
3612    control = rng.standard_normal(n_rows)
3613    outcome_values = 0.5 * real + 0.4 * control + rng.standard_normal(n_rows)
3614    idx = pd.RangeIndex(n_rows)
3615    outcome = pd.Series(outcome_values, index=idx)
3616    features = {
3617        "alpha_real": pd.Series(real, index=idx),
3618        "beta_null": pd.Series(null, index=idx),
3619    }
3620    controls = {"gamma_mom": pd.Series(control, index=idx)}
3621
3622    print("=" * 72)
3623    print("feature_scan demo: planted world (alpha real, beta null)")
3624    print("=" * 72)
3625    _demo_orchestrator(outcome, features, controls)
3626    _demo_bucket(outcome, features)
3627    _demo_interaction(outcome, features)
3628    _demo_rule_fit(outcome, real, n_rows)
3629    _demo_missingness(outcome, features)
3630    _demo_discovery(outcome, features)
3631    _demo_importance(outcome, features)
3632    _demo_rule_generation(outcome, features, n_rows)
3633
3634
3635if __name__ == "__main__":
3636    run_all_examples()
